points.point: In patent litigation brought by Centripetal in France, the Paris Court indicated it will issue its decision regarding liability on January 8, 2027.
points.quote: The final hearing took place on October 8, 2026, and the Paris Court indicated that it will issue its decision as to the liability on January 8, 2027.

points.point: Cisco is unable to estimate the likelihood of loss or loss range for claims against its Brazilian subsidiary due to Brazilian judicial uncertainties.
points.quote: While we believe there is no legal basis for the alleged liability, due to the complexities and uncertainty surrounding the judicial process in Brazil and the nature of the claims asserting joint liability with the importer, we are unable to determine the likelihood of an unfavorable outcome against our Brazilian subsidiary and are unable to reasonably estimate a range of loss, if any.

points.point: Cisco's outstanding aggregate channel partner financing guarantees representing maximum potential future payments totaled $131 million as of October 24, 2026.
points.quote: The aggregate amounts of channel partner financing guarantees outstanding, representing the total maximum potential future payments under financing arrangements with third parties, was $ 131 million and $ 127 million as of October 24, 2026 and July 25, 2026, respectively.
